programme.title: La hija del mariachi

programme.title: La hija del mariachi

programme.title: La hija del mariachi

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Luego de darse cuenta de su equivocación al dudar de la fidelidad de Rosario, Emiliano comienza a planear la manera de enmendar su error. Sus amigos y familiares deberán ayudar al mariachi a recuperar a la mujer con la quiere compartir su vida

programme.title: Diomedes

programme.title: Diomedes

programme.title: La hija del mariachi

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The closing of what was once a very popular public garden in Midsomer Deverell sparks a series of murders that have Inspector Barnaby and Sgt. Troy stumped.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Following the funeral of local hotelier Karl Wainwright, his hotel's manager and a well liked Punch and Judy performer, Gregory Chambers, disappears unusually in yet another picturesque Midsomer village. Most people dismiss his disappearance completely but when he doesn't turn up, a search is conducted and a severed hand, confirmed to be Gregory's, turns up in the woods. Further deaths and a mushroom poisoning occur surrounding the beneficiaries of Karl Wainwright's will. All is not as it seems.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A man's naked body found under mysterious circumstances, within a crop circle on Sir Harry Chatwyn's wheat field, leads police to investigating how he wound up in the field after being electrocuted. While the nearby village of Midsomer Parva is abuzz with UFO mania, Barnaby is unconvinced by a local ufologist that the man's death was the result of alien activity, as he uncovers rivalries, theft and hatred during his investigations, soon after a well known burglar is found dead in another crop circle with identical injuries.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Returning home one night, in a drunken state, the local doctor of Newton Magna calls in the police after he had accidentally hit a man, yet when Barnaby and Troy arrive, the injured man is nowhere to be found. As they investigate the mystery, Barnaby encounters an old adversary who is working to help renovate the village and whose daughter is getting married to a local boy. Matters soon become complicated, when the body of the best man's father is found in a well that was being renovated, whom the detectives soon discover had disappeared on the day he was planning to run away with a local farmer's wife.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Dave Cutler, Goodman's Land's amorous postman, is found almost decapitated near the common early one morning. Newspaper girl Holly Reid (Kate Maberly) tells Barnaby that she heard music playing faintly nearby. Barnaby and Troy are aided in their investigations by local WPC Jay Nash (Gillian Kearney).

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The double murder of eccentric widow, Isobel Hewitt, and adulterous doctor, Duncan Goff, lead Barnaby and Troy into finding out more about their personal and private lives in the village of Malham Bridge. While Troy suspects an antique dealer that Isobel befriended is the culprit, Barnaby is not convinced, believing anyone the victims knew when they were alive could have been the murderer, from the doctor's wife to the local owner of a restaurant. Even Isobel's close family and members of a local fly fishing group are suspects as they investigate all possible angles.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Martin Wroath is found dead in his home in Midsomer Worthy, Barnaby is unconvinced that he committed suicide with his own shotgun in an unnecessarily complex fashion. When a second murder occurs on an assault course at a local cottage hospital, in which Wroath was a patient, the detective suspects a link between the two murders, and soon finds a wealth of hatred, jealously and lies, before discovering that rope in the village is mysteriously disappearing.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Joyce is taking part in an open-air art class, being held on the village green of Midsomer Florey, when she discovers the body of an elderly fellow student, Ruth Fairfax, concealed beneath some undergrowth shortly after a session. Just as Barnaby begins to learn that Ruth was not all she seemed to be, officers of the NIS pull him off the case. While Troy is allowed to assist them, Barnaby is left handling a local operation into a spate of thefts, yet he decides to continue his investigations in secret. In doing so, he soon turns up armed robbery, unaccounted stolen money, former criminals, and secret liaisons, before discovering that the NIS investigation is not being as thorough as it should be.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: At his family home in Upper Warden, arrogant actor Larry Smith is killed, when a summer house he walks in to as part of a promotion for the sequel to his hit film, The House of Satan, is suddenly destroyed in an explosion. His family quickly fling accusations for his murder directly at the residents of rival village, Lower Warden, leading Barnaby and Troy to determine if this is the case, especially when Larry's director, another member of the family, is electrocuted while using an exercise bike. It's not long before secrets, affairs and blackmail begin to surface from within the two villages.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: While Troy assists an attractive wildlife liaison officer with an investigation into the illegal sale of protected bird eggs, Barnaby travels to Midsomer Magna to investigate the sudden death of a man, who apparently drowned himself. While there was evidence he was desperately seeking to avoid bankruptcy, and had visited a local millionaire to get back his money from a scheme he had invested in, a post mortem reveals that he had been murdered. The two detectives soon find their investigations crossing over, when a man found to have an illegal collection of bird eggs, is also murdered, prompting concerns that the millionaire's scheme is being used to defraud many, and that someone is willing to kill to keep the scheme going.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Causton is buzzing at the opening of a new brewery on the site of a famously cursed Abbey. But excitement turns to fear when a man is found boiled to death in one of the vats. DCI Barnaby and DS Winter are puzzled; could this really be about beer?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Mahesh Sidana - butterfly collector and founding member of an elite IQ society - is found murdered, pinned to a wall in a manner akin to his treasured butterfly specimens, DCI Barnaby and DS Winter are thrust into a crime that impacts not only on their community, but internationally. With the help of an old friend, can they catch the culprit before another victim is found...?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Carver Valley’s comic festival is in full swing when the village is shocked by the murder of a former supermodel. With a scathing comic shaming several villagers as the only lead, Barnaby and Winter are left trying to separate fact from fiction.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby gets to relive his former days of sporting glory when a death at the local Rugby Club sends Barnaby and Winter into a muddle of rucks, old grudges, new romances… and artisanal chocolates?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Barnaby is less than impressed when Sarah drags him to a family friend’s wedding. But things soon go from bad to worse when tragedy strikes and Barnaby is called into action to catch a murderer with an apparent penchant for local brides.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Things take a gruesome turn when Ferrabees Circus comes to town, bringing with it a chain of sinister clown sightings, threatening notes and deathly dangerous circus acts. Barnaby will have to face up to his fears in order to solve the case

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The appearance of a headless horseman at Quitewell Hall foreshadows a number of deaths amongst an aristocratic family. programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a barrister is killed in Midsomer, suspicion falls on convicted murderer Grady Felton. Barnaby suspects he is working with an accomplice - until Grady himself is targeted in an arson attack.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The murder of a journalist has chilling echoes of a 1960s horror film starring Midsomer's own Stella Harris. When Stella's more famous sister returns after a 40-year family rift, the killings escalate, each of them reminiscent of a movie plot. Is life - and death - imitating art?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: As darkness covers Midsomer Stanton during a total eclipse of the sun, amateur astronomer Jeremy Harper is killed by a blow to the head with a meteorite. Barnaby and Jones soon discover intrigue, sexual tension and academic rivalry are rife among the star-seeking community.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Harriet Farmer wakes up after being in a coma since the night she tried to elope. Soon afterwards, a killer strikes members of a chess club. Could the attack which left Harriet for dead a year ago be linked to moves on a chess board? And where is her boyfriend Finn?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

The rigs are holding GIANT mangrove snapper, bruiser cobia, and hard-fighting jacks… but getting them to the boat is a whole different story. Fishing heavy structure means short strikes, busted hooks, shredded leaders, and fish that know exactly where to run. Around these rigs it’s not just fishing — it’s full-blown combat. If you want to land one of these beasts, you better bring extra hooks, heavy tackle, and a whole lot of patience. Easier said than done. Venice, Louisiana continues to prove why it’s one of the most action-packed fisheries in the country.

Other notable and accomplishments of Johnny's include winning First place in Comcast's 2014 season of "Trial By Laughter," placing third in the 2014 “Laughing Skull Comedy Festival” of Atlanta, and making it to the finals in the 2012 “Great American Comedy Festival”. He was named one of Ricky Gervais' Top 5 picks in the "Just Sayin” stand up contest. Johnny was recently named one of 2015's Top10, "Hot Comics to Watch" by his wife. She says that he would have a shot at the #1 spot if he would “work just a little bit harder”. He's a married man, a new dad, and his current life goal is to win just one argument with his beautiful wife.

programme.title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Avengers Reassembled
programme.desc: The Avengers must now fight one of their own, and they're not sure what to do! Cap and Thor lead the charge, but can't fend off Iron Man and Ultron's Minions. Meanwhile, Black Widow, Hawkeye and Hulk track down a signal that seems to be controlling Iron Man from a castle in the “Little Sokovia” section of New York. There they fight HYDRA and BARON VON STRUCKER and learn that YELLOWJACKET is the “bug” that infected Iron Man's suit for Ultron. To help break Iron Man free from Ultron's control, the Avengers call in their own bug...ANT MAN! Finally, the Avengers confront Ultron and his Ultron Minions as they attack Avengers' Tower. Ultron's ultimate plan: use all the data/stuff they've stolen to free the newly rebuilt IRON LEGION, destroy the Avengers, and control the world. Tony dons the hastily repaired Hulk Buster Armor and it's on! It's a huge battle as the Avengers try to save their beloved HQ and defeat Ultron. Will they succeed? And, more importantly, can their party be saved after Ultron tries to take down their Tower?The Avengers prepare for a party with a surprise guest when Ultron crashes the preparations by using mind control on Iron Man. While trying to rescue their leader, the rest of the team discovers that Baron Stucker, HYDRA, and Yellowjacket are in on Ultron's plans. While preparing for a party at Avengers' Tower, THE AVENGERS (IRON MAN, CAPTAIN AMERICA, BLACK WIDOW, HAWKEYE, THOR, HULK and VISION) notice Iron Man acting strangely. When Iron Man volunteers to go out and get more ice, they find it odd: when has Tony every volunteered to get anything? Suddenly, ULTRON appears on a screen: he's taken control of Iron Man! To make matters worse, Ultron takes over all the versions of Iron Man's armor and they fly off!

programme.title: The Book Of Obsession
programme.desc: The Knights are tasked with protecting the King's valuable Ned Knights comic book during the Bookingheim Knight-a-Con. But with all the costumed kids there, will they recognize the real Jestro and Book of Monsters coming to get them? King Halbert instructs the Knights that they must take his valuable Ned Knights comic book to the “Knight-a-Kon” in Bookingham. It will be the first be first prize at the Knight-a-Kon. But the Book of Monsters wants the book, too. Having devoured Ned Knightly comic books in it's down time it has become fanatically obsessed with the storyline. General Magmar suggests they simply attack the place and take what they want, but Jestro tells them they can't: everyone will be in costume and they'll be thousands of comics there. This calls for a clever “infiltration” mission (which will also allow Jestro to see the Kon, which he's always wanted to do.) So Jestro goes into the Kon with the BOM and some monsters. And it's easy because everyone is in costume Jestro, the BOM and their monsters fit right in at the convention and Clay and crew have their work cut out for them trying to separate fiend from fan. Macy keeps going on-and-on about the story in the King's comic book as the Knights keep a watchful eye on it. Robin even shows up in the “Minitrex” – a small version of the Fortrex he built just for the Knight-a-Kon. He's convinced he can win the costume competition that is the big closing event for the Kon. At the end of the Kon there's a big awards ceremony for “Best Costume.” The prize: “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1.” The BOM must get it and scheme to get closer to it during the costume contest. He's just…about…to get the book when…the impatient Magmar attacks! Everyone thinks it's part of the big show! “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1” is tossed from person-to-person-to-person in the melee. The Knights must do something, but they're too far away from the Fortrex to download any NEXO-Power. Robin pulls up in his Minitrex they can use it to get NEXO-Power! Robin wins the best costume for his Minitrex and wins the Ned Knightly Comic which he then gives to Macy…she deserves to read it.

programme.title: Las Pobres Ilegales
programme.desc: Una joven huye de su casa por su padrastro y se va a los EE.UU., donde descubre el abuso a los indocumentados.

programme.title: El Día del Compadre
programme.desc: Durante la víspera del Día del Compadre, los habitantes de un condominio se preparan para festejar entre risas, juegos y riñas.

programme.title: Cinco Nacos Asaltan Las Vegas
programme.desc: Un burócrata desempleado y cuatro amigos viajan a Las Vegas para asaltar un casino.

programme.title: Santa Claus
programme.desc: Santa y el mago Merlín se unen para frustrar los planes del diablo de extender la tentación entre los niños del mundo.

programme.title: Pilotos de Combate
programme.desc: Unos pilotos de la fuerza aérea investigan en una misión antidrogas y descubren a un mafioso que disfraza sus negocios.

programme.title: El fin de un imperio
programme.desc: El teniente del batallón de Rurales, José Antonio Navarrete, es considerado héroe y enemigo de los imperialistas, quienes raptan a su gran amor para atraerlo e imponerle sus condiciones políticas.

programme.title: Me llaman violencia
programme.desc: Una mujer logra escapar de los asesinos de su padre, mientras huye conoce a un hombre que le ofrece protección.

programme.title: Bello amanecer
programme.desc: La espectacular belleza de una isleña que despierta entre los pescadores las más ardientes y locas pasiones.

programme.title: Mi nombre es Gatillo
programme.desc: Un hombre llamado el "Gatillo" solo tiene violencia en su sangre y su vida está controlada por las armas.

programme.title: Veneno para las Hadas
programme.desc: Un par de amigas de 10 años, deciden preparar un veneno para las hadas, ya que una de ella se siente bruja.

programme.title: Tráiganlos vivos o muertos
programme.desc: Una mujer roba un banco mientras su cómplice y amante dispara a los banqueros protegiéndola en su huida.

programme.title: La Dinastía de Drácula
programme.desc: Drácula despierta de su tumba después de dormir por tres siglos y reclama más víctimas para su reino.

programme.title: Los dos hermanos
programme.desc: Un hombre rico y poderoso está casado con una mujer mucho más joven, la cual tiene un amante.

programme.title: Ráfaga de Plomo
programme.desc: Una banda acribilla a los asistentes de un bar y dos hermanos se disponen a encontrar a los criminales.

programme.title: Lo Negro del Negro
programme.desc: Un hombre empleado del gobierno aprovecha su posición para su beneficio apoderándose de una inmensa fortuna.

programme.title: Desvestidas y alborotadas
programme.desc: Una bella mujer es abandonada por su marido en su luna de miel, y los hombres en el hotel andan detrás de ella.

programme.title: S.O.S. Conspiración Bikini
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de mujeres hermosas, una organización internacional de terroristas crean problemas en Latinoamérica.

programme.title: El oreja rajada
programme.desc: Dos niños angustiados y un campesino hacen todo lo posible por salvar a un purasangre. El ranchero Andrés quiere deshacerse de él, pero al final reconoce los méritos del caballo.

programme.title: Kapax del Amazonas
programme.desc: Una antropóloga norteamericana viaja en un avión con su esposo, periodista y aviador. Se accidentan y caen en la mitad de la selva, él es devorado por las alimañas mientras Linda es rescatada por un aborigen.

programme.title: Caballos de acero
programme.desc: Un joven rico es aficionado al motociclismo y conoce a un teniente de la policía con quien rivaliza en aptitudes.

programme.title: El cachas de oro
programme.desc: Un conocido juez persigue a unos violadores y asesinos, hijos de Ramsés, y los mete a la cárcel, pero su padre los libera, por lo que el valiente juez se ve obligado a matarlos. Ramsés se vengará del juez matando a su prometida.

programme.title: Acapulqueña
programme.desc: Un millonario decide montar un espectáculo con una mujer de Acapulco y dos hombres se enamoran de ella.

programme.title: El oficio más antiguo del mundo
programme.desc: Un hombre perseguido es ayudado por unas prostitutas que le acogen y ocultan en la casa donde ellas trabajan.

programme.title: Los fugitivos
programme.desc: Cuatro jóvenes narcotraficantes huyen de la policía y se esconden en un rancho donde hay tres mujeres.

programme.title: Yo fui novio de Rosita Alvírez
programme.desc: Un charro se emborracha y llora al recordar a su novia, una coqueta mujer que terminó muerta en manos de uno de sus pretendientes.

programme.title: Arsenio Lupin
programme.desc: Un millonario contrata a Sherlock Holmes para que atrape a Arsenio Lupin, un ladrón elegante que roba a los ricos para repartir los botines que consigue entre los pobres.

programme.title: La Isla de las Mujeres
programme.desc: Un limpiabotas sueña que cae al mar y llega a una isla habitada por 600 mujeres que ejercen un matriarcado.

programme.title: No me quieras tanto
programme.desc: Un hombre cumple una condena de cinco años y, cuando queda libre, jura vengarse del empresario que lo hizo encarcelar.

programme.title: Tierra de violencia
programme.desc: El hijo de un comisario asesinado se encuentra en problemas cuando descubre que el pueblo ha sido estafado.

programme.title: Mi noche de bodas
programme.desc: En su noche de bodas, una joven humilde recién casada con un boticario recibe una pulsera de brillantes con una nota que pone en duda su honestidad, aunque ella jura y perjura su inocencia.

programme.title: Mi Ley es un Revólver
programme.desc: Un justiciero ayuda a la dueña de unos terrenos que podría ser despojada por un ranchero de una indemnización millonaria.

programme.title: Papá Lebonard
programme.desc: Con su gran sencillez y bondad, papá Leonard vence la hipocresía y los falsos valores de su esposa.

programme.title: La Conquista de El Dorado
programme.desc: Siete pistoleros viajan por el desierto y luchan por sobrevivir mientras buscan El Dorado.

programme.title: Plazos Traicioneros
programme.desc: Una joven mesera conoce a un ex productor de cine que acaba de salir de prisión y la hace estrella de cine.

programme.title: Sota, caballo y rey
programme.desc: Un bandido arma una intriga para convertirse en el dueño de un rancho, hasta que los hijos del dueño real lo descubren.

programme.title: Y mañana serán mujeres
programme.desc: Una maestra es invitada por los padres de algunas de sus alumnas a pasar las vacaciones de verano en un rancho.

programme.title: Aventuras de Joselito y Pulgarcito
programme.desc: Un niño español se embarca rumbo a México para buscar a su padre y se hace amigo de un niño vendedor de periódicos.

programme.title: María Cristina
programme.desc: Una joven sorprende a la esposa de su jefe con el amante y para ayudar dice que es suyo, pero el patrón descubre todo.

programme.title: Hay ángeles con espuelas
programme.desc: Un hombre mujeriego, que todos pensaban muerto, regresa para visitar a su abuela con una gran sorpresa.

programme.title: Mis hijos
programme.desc: Veinte años de haber sufrido un accidente, una mujer recupera la memoria e intenta desesperadamente encontrar a sus tres hijos.

programme.title: Los malvados
programme.desc: Un anciano es defendido por tres bandidos de unos asaltantes, y cuando muere, les pide que cuiden de su joven nieta.

programme.title: Tlayucán
programme.desc: Por una situación límite, un hombre se convierte en ladrón. Si su identidad se conoce, sus vecinos podrían lincharlo. La única persona amable de la ciudad es el sacerdote local.

programme.title: Asesinos de la noche
programme.desc: Un hombre manda a matar a un enemigo, pero su orden no es acatada. Lleno de furia, asesina al matón y persigue por su cuenta a su rival.

programme.title: Cena de matrimonios
programme.desc: Cinco hombres ricos reciben llamadas afirmando que sus esposas los engañan, pero creen que es una broma.

programme.title: Bamba
programme.desc: Un hombre se entusiasma con una humilde mujer que remienda redes para pescar, pero el problema es que él está casado con una mujer rica.

programme.title: Los hijos de Don Venancio
programme.desc: Un comerciante queda viudo con cinco hijos a su cargo, quienes le dan severos problemas con su comportamiento.

programme.title: La Mafia del Crimen
programme.desc: Un apostador obliga a un médico a curar a un cómplice herido, pero este muere y la amante del muerto se enamora del galeno.

programme.title: Ventarrón
programme.desc: Un gánster explota a dos mujeres enamoradas de él, pero, a su vez, él se enamora de una joven y le promete cambiar de vida.

programme.title: El Calvario de una Madre
programme.desc: Una mujer exige justicia luego de enterarse de que su hijo homosexual, un marino, fue asesinado por sus compañeros.

programme.title: Los Nietos de Don Venancio
programme.desc: Un hombre vuelve a España para un festejo familiar y se entera de que ha ocurrido un incendio en su tienda.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As summer gets into full swing there is plenty for Monty to be doing at Longmeadow. He gets to grips with summer pruning as he tackles his espaliered pear trees. Nature's bounty is very much in evidence at Lord Rothschild's garden at Waddesdon Manor.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Music-loving couple Paul and Victoria welcome Charlie and the Rich Brothers to their retro-styled home in Coventry. With an original Anderson shelter in place and its owners bursting with imagination, this space is ready for a creative makeover.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Charlie and the Rich Brothers meet Arvinder and Yolanda, a couple juggling older parents, twin babies and busy careers. Their garden has fallen into disrepair, so the team heads to south London to make a space where the family can stop and reflect.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: In Leicester the team meet Paul, a personal trainer who would like to use his space for clients, as well as for relaxing with friends and family. Can the team give him an all-purpose garden that also takes into consideration his disability?

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Charlie Dimmock and the Rich Brothers are tasked with bringing a tropical vibe to a sparse garden in Lincolnshire. Lizzie and Mike want the colours and feel of an island getaway, so which design will they choose?

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don is in and around Rome, a power base of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don visits gardens in Florence and the Tuscan countryside, discovering that renaissance gardens were created as works of art.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don is in Naples visiting some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the scenery of the Amalfi Coast.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.sub-title: The Veneto, Lucca and The Lakes
programme.desc: Monty Don concludes his garden tour of Italy in the wealthy north where, in the Veneto and Lucca, extravagant pleasure gardens were created for flirtation and fun.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Now that the rambling roses have finished flowering, Monty turns his attention to pruning and tying in new growth for a good display next year. On the 20th anniversary of the death of Geoff Hamilton, Adam Frost returns to Barnsdale to pay tribute.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Joe Swift pays a visit to the Northumberland garden of Chris Mullins who, after over twenty years as a Member of Parliament, has turned his attention to the renovation of his walled garden.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Charge your glasses as Joe Swift visits a 'drinkable' allotment in London where much of the produce is grown to make beer, wine and cider. Carol Klein looks at the capsules of potential that herald the start and end of most plants' lives: seeds.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty's dividing his Pulmonaria and gives advice on frost-protection, Joe visits a tropical oasis outside Bristol, and Carol looks at Rowans from around the world.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don prepares the flowering borders for winter and makes a bonfire, Carol celebrates our berry-laden hedgerows, and Rachel visits Julian Clary in his garden.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty shows how to stake dahlias, sows seeds of perennials and celebrates an abundant vegetable harvest. The team meet a landscape designer in Cornwall who creates gardens that are not only sustainable but also beautiful and edible.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: There's plenty to do to prepare for the season to come, and Monty Don is clearing out spent crops and mulching his asparagus. Joe Swift's been to visit Wayne and Geraldine Hemingway, to see how they combine sustainability with their designer-style.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Now that birds are no longer nesting in hedges, now is the time to get them looking trim and neat and Monty has plenty of tips on how to cut them so that they grow well. Alan Power visits Croome Park in Worcestershire.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With the bank holiday ahead there's plenty of opportunity to catch up with some essential jobs in the garden and Monty gives a masterclass on how to look after and prune soft fruit to ensure maximum production next year.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty and the regular team are joined by some new faces offering tips, advice and inspiration from gardens large and small across the country. In this programme Monty will be at Longmeadow catching up with some seasonal jobs.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is at Longmeadow giving advice on how to deal with unruly roses, taking cuttings of herbs and planting a new tree. Carol Klein continues her series on plant families, exploring some of the most popular relations of the rose.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: September is the perfect time for planting and Monty adds some autumn flowering asters to his borders as well as refreshing his strawberry beds with new stock. Carol Klein continues her series on plant families.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: There's plenty of advice from Longmeadow this week, as Monty starts to tidy up the garden for autumn and reviews this year's display in the jewel garden. In the final part of Carol Klein's series on plant families she looks at the Apiaceae family.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty catches up with seasonal jobs at Longmeadow when he divides some perennials and plants alpines for spring colour. He also meets Helen Dillon to find out why she is planning to leave her famous garden after decades of honing it to perfection.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: After months of nurturing the plants in his garden, Monty reaps a harvest of a different kind when he investigates how productive his bees have been at making honey. Joe Swift visits the world-famous Chatsworth House in Derbyshire.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: There is a visitor at Longmeadow this week, when Rachel de Thame lends Monty a hand as he refreshes his dry garden with plants that will thrive in tricky growing conditions. Monty also visits a national collection of vines.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty gives advice on the plants that need winter protection and thinks ahead to colourful spring bouquets. The glory of summer may be over in most gardens, but Carol goes to Worcestershire in search of some autumn colour.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty kicks off the gardening year from Longmeadow as he shares his tips for pruning, planting up pots for spring colour and sharing his plans for the year. At Packwood House, the extraordinary herbaceous borders come under Adam Frost's scrutiny.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty is mulching the borders in preparation for spring and potting up his dahlias for the year ahead. Carol Klein celebrates her plant of the month, and Frances Tophill is at the Andromeda Botanic Gardens in Barbados.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty starts his plans for his revamped courtyard garden when he plants bare root trees. Also, Nick Bailey explores the strange world of lichens and finds out how these plants grow and thrive on trees, wood and stone.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: The team is in Liphook with a challenge on their hands. Anne and Shaun have a big garden, and a daughter who has her own ideas on what makes a perfect outdoor space. Can the Rich brothers save the day, or will Charlie's design suit the family best?

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Tracey and Rob's Newport home has it all: dangerous sloped banks, a multi-level space full of wild weeds, overgrown hedges and too many trees. For those brave enough to make it to the top, however, the garden offers a magnificent view.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Charlie and the brothers go head to head to win the right to make over the garden of Christine and Tony, who were shot in a terrorist attack in Tunisia in June 2015. If ever a couple needed the peace and consoling virtues of a garden, it is this one.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Charlie and the Rich brothers are in Northampton at the garden of Theresa and Martyn. The couple have retired and with their children moved out and providing them with grand children, they would like to enjoy a formal cottage garden.

programme.title: Monty Don's Japanese Gardens
programme.desc: Monty continues his travels to learn about the art of Japanese stonemasonry and the famous tea ceremonies and their accompanying gardens, before finally taking a lesson in the delicate art of traditional flower arranging.

programme.title: Monty Don's Japanese Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don returns to Japan during the fiery blaze of autumn. He visits the three great gardens of Japan to learn how they protect the garden from the coming winter and learns how the Japanese are weaving nature into their concrete urban jungle.

programme.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across Central Spain. He begins at the vast, imposing palace and garden of the Escorial before heading for Madrid, Toledo, other parts of Castile and finally Valencia.

programme.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don is in the south of Spain, visiting gardens that show how this part of the country has evolved thanks to influences from visitors and settlers from ancient to modern times.

programme.title: Monty Don's Spanish Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels across northern Spain, visiting gardens across this vast and diverse landscape that changes from an Atlantic to a Mediterranean climate as he journeys from Galicia to Catalonia.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Adam Frost and Advolly Richmond celebrate the horticultural genius of William Robinson in the gardens of his former home, Gravetye Manor in Sussex. Sue Kent gives her own garden some TLC.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty harvests his spuds and sows seeds for autumn veg. He also shows how to get plants for free by taking cuttings.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: At Longmeadow, Monty shows how to harvest and store potatoes. He also adds late summer colour to the cottage garden and prunes shrub roses. Carol Klein travels to Norfolk to meet Adrian Bloom, a member of a horticultural dynasty.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don travels from the north-west coast of Scotland to the north-east coast of England, from historic reconstructions to modern re-inventions. He visits some of the most inhospitable places in the country and finds gardens that are flourishing.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across some of the country's landscapes, heading across the north of England to Northern Ireland. Here, Monty sees the ingenuity, passion and determination of British people to garden and create gardens, no matter what the canvas.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.sub-title: What Genetic Testing Brings to Ancestry
programme.desc: Labs that provide DNA ancestry information use hundreds of thousands of ancestry-information markers, or AIMs; learning about the AIMs that relate to major identifiable lineages; what can be gleaned from mitochondrial DNA and Y-DNA.

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: There are many social issues affecting an individual's emotional response to receiving DNA ancestry results; how the reciprocal engagement method can help families face unexpected ancestry results; tips to consider before ordering one's own test.

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.sub-title: When Family Narrative Meets Genetic Testing
programme.desc: People want a family narrative, whereas DNA just "wants" to move itself forward and is neutral on issues of race, subterfuge or social connection; how to create a strategic family narrative to incorporate the scientific facts of DNA ancestry results.

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.sub-title: Privacy Versus Connection in DNA Testing
programme.desc: From the case of Henrietta Lacks to that of the Hagahai people of Papua New Guinea, scientists and government agencies have a history of bad actions with respect to biological samples; learn about the laws and programs in place to protect privacy.

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: Learning about the DNA Discussion Project and its goals; current results regarding the ways in which DNA ancestry tests are changing identity; looking at questions about unanticipated results, sharing DNA ancestry results and social implications.

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: A genogram is a graphic tool used to explore family history and relationships over a two- to three-generation period, discovering the powerful information that can be conveyed through a genogram as opposed to the traditional family tree diagram.

programme.title: Identity in the Age of Ancestral DNA
programme.desc: Exploring the issue of birth assisted by reproductive technologies by meeting Maria, who learns as a teenager that she was born with the help of intrauterine insemination; considering how this knowledge affects an adolescent's identity.

programme.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age
programme.desc: Philip II of Macedon sets the stage for the rise of his son, Alexander the Great, by conquering Greece; when Alexander invades the Persian territory of Asia Minor in 334 B.C., he embarks on the greatest career of conquest the world has ever seen.

programme.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age
programme.desc: After only two battles, Alexander commands more land than any Greek before him; he orders the Persian emperor to address him as an equal; at the height of his power, he visits Egypt, where he assumes the title of pharaoh and is hailed as a deity.

programme.title: Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Age
programme.desc: Whether his Egyptian sojourn convinces Alexander that he is a god or just teaches him the political value of blurring the lines between human and divine; how Alexander brings the Persian emperor to battle as he resumes his drive eastward.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.sub-title: How Do Archaeologists Know Where to Dig?
programme.desc: The methods archeologists use in looking for sites; the uses of remote sensing technologies, which enable archeologists to visualize objects obscured by vegetation and soil; investigating ground surveys, which reveal information before digging.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: Prehistoric archeology allows one to glimpse the earliest times in hominid and human history; learning about seminal 20th-century finds of hominids in Africa; discovering the figural cave paintings of Lascaux, Altamira and Chauvet.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: Significant Neolithic sites; exploring Gobekli Tepe, whose stone rings are the oldest known examples of monumental architecture in the early Near East; the tombs and tower of Jericho; Catalhoyuk is noted for its houses without doors or windows.

programme.title: Archaeology: An Introduction to the World's Greatest Sites
programme.desc: A first look at the wonders of Egyptology; the deciphering of hieroglyphics; the techniques of ancient Egyptian embalming and mummification; the stories behind the building of the Step Pyramid of Zozer, the Pyramids at Giza and the Sphinx.

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture
programme.sub-title: Alexander the Great: Greek Culture Spreads
programme.desc: The conquests of Alexander the Great give birth to the Hellenistic world; Alexander's military expansionism brings a vast geographical area under the Greek civilization; Alexander's empire fragments after his death; Alexandria, a center of learning.

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture
programme.desc: The conflicted relationship between the Greeks and their Roman conquerors; Greek culture's impact on Rome; the founding of the Byzantine Empire, its flourishing of scholarship and theology; the role of Islamic scholars in preserving Greek learning.

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture
programme.desc: Constantinople's fall in 1453; the Greeks under the Ottomans; Europe rediscovers classical antiquity; the philosophical spirit of the Renaissance, which brings a sudden interest in the ancient Greeks; the influence of Greek mythology on Western art.

programme.title: The Greek World: A Study of History and Culture
programme.sub-title: The Birth of the Greek Nation-State
programme.desc: The struggle of the Greeks under the Ottomans; European intellectuals and Europe's major powers support the movement to free Greece; the nation-state of Greece in 1830; Greece's territorial expansion; its tumultuous modern history up to the present.

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity
programme.desc: The influence of philosophy on the morality and conduct of Rome's ruling classes; an influence rarely matched in the Western tradition; Christian theologians employing the doctrines of these two philosophical schools in defining their own faith.

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity
programme.desc: Knowing what role Judaism plays in the Roman Empire; learning how Rome's experience with this stalwart monotheistic faith, the first it has encountered, differs from the challenge of the Christian faith that emerges from it.

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity
programme.desc: The first years of efforts to convert people to Christianity; the early leadership by James of those who are often called Jewish Christians; the career of Paul, from his own conversion after a vision to his work propagating the message of Jesus.

programme.title: The Fall of the Pagans and the Origins of Medieval Christianity
programme.desc: Early responses to Christianity; the violent persecutions in Rome under Nero; the legalistic and easily avoided persecutions under later emperors; Roman ignorance of Christianity; the eventual momentum that ignorance gives the new faith.

programme.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor
programme.desc: As the Hittites unite Anatolia, early Greeks called Achaeans visit its western reaches; Achaean warlords trade and raid along the shores of Asia Minor; in time, they become the first Greeks to clash with the armies of a great king to the east.

programme.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor
programme.desc: The most enduring legacies from early Anatolia are "The Iliad" and "The Odyssey": how the siege of Troy and the exploits of Homer's warrior chieftains fit into the wider tale of imperial struggle and decline during the Greek Dark Age.

programme.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor
programme.sub-title: Iron Age Kingdoms of Asia Minor
programme.desc: From 1200 B.C. to 1000 B.C., migrations reshape Anatolia; Phrygians come from the Balkans, only to be overcome by Cimmerian nomads; in the West, Hittite provincials found trade-rich Lydia, whose last king is Croesus.

programme.title: Great Ancient Civilizations of Asia Minor
programme.desc: From 750 B.C., the Greeks distinguish themselves with the polis, a city-state based on citizen rule; by 500 B.C., Athens devises the first democratic constitution, with all adult male citizens forming the sovereign assembly.

programme.title: Reconsidering JFK

programme.title: Reconsidering JFK
programme.sub-title: JFK's Pivotal Choices to Win the Presidency

programme.title: Liberty on Trial in America: Cases That Defined Freedom

programme.title: Liberty on Trial in America: Cases That Defined Freedom
